models_evaluated: federated learning updated IMPACT models (2 approaches)

links.outcome: Discrimination, calibration and precision of federated-updated versus original IMPACT and single-study models
links.effect: Federated models had similar AUC (0.77-0.88) to original and single-study models, were well-calibrated, had higher precision, and reduced the impact of missing data.
links.quote: Compared to the original IMPACT and single-study models, both federated models presented similar discrimination (AUC), were well-calibrated, were more efficient (higher precision), and reduced the impact of missing data in model estimation.

unlisted_practices: Privacy-preserving federated learning infrastructure for multi-study/multi-country model validation and updating without sharing patient-level data

screen.reason: Empirically tests and evaluates a federated learning deployment infrastructure across multi-continental cohorts (TRACK-TBI and CENTER-TBI) to validate and recalibrate prognostic clinical prediction models without centralizing sensitive patient data.

primary.practice: federated learning for decentralized multi-site validation and updating
